finalCta.paragraph: History: The EH5 is the newer, more efficient 1.5L BlueHDi introduced in 2019, offering improved emissions and fuel economy over the older 1.6L DV5 units. It was primarily fitted to Active, Allure and GT Line trims in the second-generation 3008. The engine code Y01 is sometimes used in vehicle documentation.
